title: Right against Exploitation & Freedom of Religion
quote: Propagate does NOT include a right to convert - it would impinge on the other's freedom of conscience

boxes.title: Articles 23-28 at a glance
head: Art.
Right
Available to
rows: No **traffic in human beings**, **begar**, forced labour
Citizens + non-citizens; ==against State and private persons==
No child below **14** in factory, mine, hazardous work
No **taxes** to promote a particular religion

boxes.title: Arts 23-24: key points
items: **Begar** = forced unpaid labour by officials/zamindars
**23(2)**: compulsory **public service** allowed; no discrimination on religion, race, caste, class
Art. 24 does **not** bar harmless work
==**21A + 24**== make exploitation right meaningful for children (APPSC G1 2022)
Related DPSP: **39(e)/(f)**

items.what: **Child Labour Act**; 2016: Child and Adolescent Labour Act

boxes.title: Art. 25: text, powers, limits
items: Subject to ==**public order, morality, health**== + other Part III
**25(2)(a)**: regulate secular activity linked to religion
**25(2)(b)**: social reform; throw open **Hindu** institutions
**Expl. I**: **kirpan** = Sikh profession
**Expl. II**: "Hindus" includes **Sikh, Jaina, Buddhist**
**Conscience** includes freedom to follow no religion

boxes.title: Religion cases
head: Case
Holding
rows: Propagate ≠ convert; upheld Orissa (**1967**), MP (**1968**) Acts
Not compelled to sing National Anthem
5-judge, ==**4:1**==; women's bar struck down; not a denomination

boxes.title: Indian vs Western secularism
head: Indian (positive)
Western (negative)
rows: Principled distance, equal respect (**Sarva Dharma Sambhava**)

boxes.title: Secularism: cases & roots
items: **Kesavananda (1973)**: basic structure; **S.R. Bommai (1994)**: ==basic feature==, Art. 356
**Abhiram Singh (2017)**: religion appeal = corrupt practice, Sec. 123(3) RPA
Roots: **Nehru Report (1928)**, **Karachi Resolution (1931)**
CA rejected **'God'** in Preamble (**1949**); **Art. 325**: no exclusion from rolls

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Right to religion = **Fundamental Right** (APPSC 2019)
Quoted text of **25(1)** → identify Article (2018, 2023)
Trap: "not applicable to irreligious" is NOT a component (APPSC-G1 2018); "Religious state" not a feature
First women of barred age at Sabarimala: ==**Bindu Ammini, Kanaka Durga**== (Jan 2019)
Review: **9-judge Bench**, CJI **Surya Kant**; Art. 27 bars taxes, not fees
Malinowski: **death** as source of religion (APPSC-G2 2023); Ahura Mazda = good, Angra Mainyu = evil
